content: {"praised":["Action scenes are exciting and well choreographed","Humor is light‑hearted and breezy","Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Yuen Biao are strong performers","Fight between Jackie and Benny is a highlight","Fans of martial arts will enjoy the final battles"],"criticized":["Bootleg quality makes audio and video questionable","Not as definitive as other Jackie Chan classics","Pacing is slow for an action movie","Sammo Hung’s role is limited to story, not action","Not a standout compared to Police Story or Rumble in the Bronx"]}
